html:
SMTO-MON-0001 — SMTO couldn't find that monitor

GUID: e357aad3-aa86-4c59-95ec-f322b4191212
Slug: monitor-not-found
Domain: MON · Subsystem: mon

What happened

  • A monitor (a background check that runs a command on a computer at set times) with that ID doesn't exist, so nothing was started, stopped or read. Your other monitors weren't affected.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In a conversation, ask the agent to list your monitors, for example: “Show my monitors, including archived ones.” The list shows the monitors that exist now, so you can pick the right one.
  2. Ask the agent to act on the monitor from that list, using its exact ID or title. The earlier request used an ID that doesn't match any saved monitor.
  3. If the monitor isn't in the list, ask the agent to start a new monitor for the same check. The monitor may have been deleted or cleared by data cleanup, and it can't be brought back by its old ID.

What success looks like

  • The agent shows the monitor's status or readings instead of this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the monitor's title, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep resending the old ID; it will fail the same way.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The monitor manager or store found no record for the requested monitor_id during a lookup, start, cancel, archive, observation read, event stream or judgment reservation.

What this means

  • The monitor manager/store cannot find the requested monitor record before a lookup, control, observation read or judgment reservation. Monitor validation does not execute the observation command. Existing monitor state and stored observations remain authoritative; missing planning support or exhausted judgment budget does not prove observation collection failed.

Why this can happen

  • The monitor manager/store cannot find the requested monitor record before a lookup, control, observation read or judgment reservation.

How to diagnose it

  • Refresh the current monitor inventory and verify the owning Controller and exact ID.

How to fix it

  • List monitors (GET /api/agent/monitors with include_archived=true, or monitor.inspect with operation=list) and use a current monitor_id. Records can disappear through deletion, pruning or a runtime purge; see AgentMonitorManager in src/agent_runtime/monitors/manager.py.
  • Refresh the monitor list and select a current monitor ID.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended existing monitor is selected from its current inventory.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • Monitor validation does not execute the observation command. Existing monitor state and stored observations remain authoritative; missing planning support or exhausted judgment budget does not prove observation collection failed.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
